what: what the maker states of the Vorpal MG90 Micro Servo, a servo class: ratings and nominals, no measurement
document: Vorpal Robotics wiki, Vorpal MG90 Micro Servo (the maker's own page for the servo; it links no PDF sheet), https://www.vorpalrobotics.com/wiki/index.php/Vorpal_MG90_Micro_Servo, page last edited 2018-08-01, read 2026-11-14

stands_for.mg90-d: a Vorpal MG90, so the page is its own maker's statement: the owner's word. Its motor and its body are of two new servos of the brand, not a factory pair (the registry's notes)

maker_claim.of: its relation to the TowerPro MG90S
quoted: We contracted directly with Tower Pro to create these servos
The gears and plastic housing are identical to standard Tower Pro MG90S servos
maker_claim.standing: the maker's claim, quoted as the page prints it: nothing here checks it, and no value of the TowerPro record (mg90s.datasheet.json) is taken on its strength

not_stated: the page states no current of any kind, travel, dead band, pulse range, temperature range, motor type or gear material
left_out: the page also states the weight, the size and the lead, in the lines as printed: no limit is taken from them. The page prints the multiplication sign in the size, written x here, and the torque's unit as kg/cm, recorded as kg cm
